sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Wir wissen Ihre Hinweise zu den gestiegenen Lohn‑ und Metallkosten und unsere langjährige Partnerschaft sehr zu schätzen. Der verbindliche Abnahmeumfang steht direkt nach diesem Absatz; unsere Bestellung ist fix und umfasst unsere komplette Abnahme über die Vertragslaufzeit ausschließlich bei Ihnen. Einen höheren Stückpreis können wir allerdings nicht akzeptieren; im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen die langfristige Vertragslaufzeit zur Planungssicherheit an. Können Sie die Lieferung der gesamten Abnahme über die Laufzeit zusagen?

We confirm a binding volume of 4000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:PH-100).
Your letter (doc:D01-LETTER) gives less notice than our agreement provides for (ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK).
We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

On this basis we propose: EUR 48.88 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We highly value our long-standing partnership and confirm that we can guarantee the delivery of your entire volume of 4000 units per year over the 24-month term.
We acknowledge your reference to the notice period and have adjusted the effective date to 1 February 2027 to fully respect our framework agreement.
In exchange for the extended contract and the delayed effective date, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms and propose a revised price of EUR 50.40 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and valid from 1 February 2027: €50.10 per unit.
Our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for the clear update — we appreciate that you have moved toward us and that your family-run foundry can guarantee delivery of our full demand over the term. Please note our order volume is fixed and, in turn, we are offering a long contract term to provide planning security for your operation. Our proposal continues to move toward you and we value your willingness to take the price, cost and notice data into account.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 49.10 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-02-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €49.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We appreciate your revised offer and the confirmation of the 24-month term.
We have reviewed the delivery scorecard you referenced; our delivery performance remains solid and does not justify a further discount.
To reciprocate your movement and move closer to an agreement, we can offer €49.70 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 February 2027 with 30-day payment terms.
Our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Wir erkennen Ihre stabile Lieferleistung an und möchten darauf hinweisen, dass unser Bestellvolumen fest ist und unseren gesamten Bedarf für dieses Teil bei Ihnen umfasst, während wir im Gegenzug einen langen Vertragszeitraum anbieten, der Ihnen Planungssicherheit bringt. Unser Vorschlag geht Ihnen damit weiter entgegen, wir schätzen Ihre Anpassung, und der vollständige Vorschlag mit allen Konditionen folgt nach den Daten.

On this basis we propose: EUR 49.28 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-02-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build on the long relationship between our companies, a partnership rooted in regional craftsmanship and mutual trust. For our family-run foundry, delivering the highest quality to our valued partners is a matter of proud tradition. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We have already made our final step to €49.40, which represents a fair compromise for both sides. Our offer stands at a price of €49.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Please accept this price so we can conclude our negotiations and focus on production. We look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
